# time_queue v1.2.3 - Table of Contents

## Pages

- [TimeQueue](https://time-queue.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)

## Modules

- [TimeQueue](https://time-queue.hexdocs.pm/TimeQueue.md): Implements a timers queue based on a list of maps. The queue can be encoded
as JSON.
- [TimeQueue.GbTrees](https://time-queue.hexdocs.pm/TimeQueue.GbTrees.md): Implements a timers queue based on [gb_trees](http://erlang.org/doc/man/gb_trees.html).
- [TimeQueue.TimeInterval](https://time-queue.hexdocs.pm/TimeQueue.TimeInterval.md): Utility to parse and format time intervals represented as strings.
